artworks.title: Studies of Women's Heads
artworks.medium: black and red chalk heightened with white chalk on light brown laid paper, with later framing line in brown ink
artworks.description: This image shows detailed drawings of multiple young women's faces with partial necks visible. The women face various directions with delicate facial features, soft expressions, and gentle smiles. They have large, expressive eyes and varying hairstyles, some with headbands or ornaments. One woman wears an earring. The artwork is on a textured background, likely paper.

artworks.title: Delilah Cutting Samson's Hair
artworks.artist: Raphael Sadeler I after Joos van Winghe
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene of combat in an architectural setting. The image shows a group of armored warriors engaged in a skirmish within a building with classical columns and arches. In the center, several figures are entangled in a struggle, with some bare-chested and holding weapons. One figure appears seated with a raised hand, surrounded by others in dynamic poses. The use of hatching and shading intensifies the scene, capturing action and interactions. The architectural backdrop adds grandeur and context to the moment depicted.

artworks.title: Solomon Led to Idolatry by His Wives
artworks.artist: Raphael Sadeler I after Joos van Winghe
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 22.6 x 28.9 cm (8 7/8 x 11 3/8 in.)
overall (external frame dimensions): 59.7 x 44.5 cm (23 1/2 x 17 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of people in a classical setting. At the center, a bearded man wearing a crown is seated on a throne, surrounded by richly dressed women. Some women are gesturing, with one holding a child. The background features columns, arches, and a tapestry. Through an archway on the left, there is a glimpse of an outdoor scene with trees and buildings.

artworks.title: Sardanapalus among the Concubines
artworks.artist: Raphael Sadeler I after Joos van Winghe
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ancient interior scene with classical figures and ornate decoration. The artwork shows a detailed historical scene set in an opulent interior with several figures seated on a raised platform. Draped fabric and an archway frame the background. The figures appear to be in motion or engaged in an expressive interaction, indicating a narrative or mythological moment. The clothing, furniture, and architectural elements are intricately detailed with elaborate linework.

artworks.title: Heliogabalus and the Wise Women
artworks.artist: Raphael Sadeler I after Joos van Winghe
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an opulent interior scene featuring multiple figures and a monkey. The figures are portrayed in an elaborate, classical setting, engaged in conversation or other activities, with some seated on thrones or steps and others standing or gesturing. The scene includes sumptuous drapery, with an intricately set table in the middle and ornate architectural details in the background.

artworks.title: Gothischer Kreuzgang (Gothic Cloister)
artworks.description: The image shows a Gothic cloister. It depicts a covered walkway with columns and arches, leading towards an open courtyard. The scene portrays a courtyard with architectural details, including a well or fountain, trees, and distant structures. The artwork uses fine lines to show the stone textures and medieval design. The color scheme is monochromatic, focusing on light and shadow for depth.

artworks.title: The Thames at Battersea
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a calm scene at water level, slightly to the side of a body of water. The horizon is at the midpoint, where land and sky meet. Structures like a windmill and red brick buildings are visible on the horizon. The painting has soft brushstrokes, giving the water a reflective quality. The color palette includes hues of pale blue, soft whites, and earthy browns. In the foreground, two figures in a boat are handling a net, with reeds nearby. In the background, there are trees against a cloud-filled sky.

artworks.title: The Card Game (Der kleine l'Hombre Tisch)
artworks.medium: etching and sulfur tint with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals sitting at a table. Two individuals are seen from behind, displaying elaborate head coverings and attire. The third person faces forward, visible from the waist up. This person has delicate facial features and wears a head covering with lace or ornately woven material. They are all dressed in garments from an earlier time period, with long sleeves and layers of fabric. They sit around a small table with a lit candle in an ornate candlestick. One individual appears to be holding cards. The background is plain, emphasizing the focus on the people and their clothing.

artworks.title: The Four Elements
artworks.description: This image depicts mythological figures in a nature setting. The figures are interacting with each other amidst swirling clouds and a detailed landscape with plant life and a rocky structure. One figure in the upper left holds a bird, while another on the right holds a dagger above a creature. The central figure at the bottom wears a foliage wreath and holds stalks of grain. The illustration features intricate linework and shading, creating a textured and dynamic appearance.

artworks.title: Eros and Anteros
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in a seated position, both bodies are fully visible. The figure on the left leans backwards while the figure on the right leans in closely towards them, their lips meeting. The male figure has curly hair, and the female figure has hair styled in a loose updo. Both figures are mostly nude, with some drapery covering parts of their lower bodies and wrapped around the male figure's shoulder. They are each holding a torch that emits thick, swirling smoke. The background features a rocky landscape with a sparse tree on the left side and rolling hills extending into the distance.

artworks.title: Without Ceres and Bacchus, Venus Would Freeze
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical mythological scene. The artwork depicts three nude figures engaged in an earthy, revelrous setting. One figure, on the left, is crowned with grapevines and holding a goblet aloft. The central female figure is adorned with jewelry and gazes away, her arm forming an arch over a cask, while the figure on the right, with wings, holds clusters of grapes and other foliage. They appear surrounded by lush fruit and a rich landscape, including a detailed tree in the background. The scene is highly detailed, with an emphasis on musculature and classical drapery.

artworks.title: Colonade et Jardins du Palais Medicis (Colonnade and Gardens of the Medici Palace)
artworks.medium: etching and wash-manner printed in yellow, blue, red, and blackon pale green paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark at top & bottom): 29.1 x 24.4 cm (11 7/16 x 9 5/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ivan E. Phillips and Jacqueline Getty Phillips
artworks.description: The image shows a grand staircase and columns of a building, viewed from a low angle. The horizon is not visible, with the focus on the architectural elements and the sky. The sky and trees in the background provide the backdrop. The architectural details, such as carvings on an urn and building façade, are depicted with a precise, linear technique. The color palette includes earth tones, light blues, and greys. In the foreground, an artist sketches on the ground, with period-dressed observers nearby. Columns of the building and sculptures lead the eye upwards to the sky with clouds.

artworks.title: August in the Country - The Sea Shore
artworks.description: The image is an illustration of a bustling beach scene on a sunny day. Various activities are taking place along the shore, from people interacting to a man proudly displaying a lobster. In the background, sailboats and waves can be seen. The artwork features fine brushstrokes, intricate detailing, and a monochrome color palette of black, white, and gray.

artworks.title: Young America Rising at the Ballot-Box and Strangling the Serpents: Disunion and Secession
The Army of the Potomac - A Sharp-Shooter on Picket Duty
artworks.description: The image depicts a person sitting on a tree branch, aiming a rifle. They are dressed in a dark uniform with knee-high boots. A metal canteen hangs from a nearby branch. The background consists of pine tree branches.

artworks.title: Thanksgiving in Camp
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a camp scene during a break at a military encampment. The image depicts a group of individuals gathered around makeshift seating composed of crates and logs. Some are seated, while others are standing, engaging with one another. They are dressed in military-style uniforms. In the foreground, a small campfire is burning, with a few cooking utensils nearby. Behind, the scene extends to a tent, with signs indicating items like "Herrings," "Cider," and "Sutler." The background shows a series of tents stretching across the landscape.

artworks.title: Home from the War
artworks.description: The image shows a moment with several individuals engaged in close interactions. There are men and women, some in military uniforms and some in civilian clothing. The men have mustaches and military caps, while the women wear bonnets or shawls. One couple is in the center, with the woman wearing a voluminous dress. Another woman, facing left, is holding onto a soldier’s arm. The scene features typical 19th-century clothing, with large skirts and detailed headwear. In the background, there is a crowd of people with blurred facial details. The illustration style uses intricate linework to depict the moment.

artworks.title: "Any Thing for Me, If You Please?" - Post Office of the Brooklyn Fair in Aid of the Sanitary Commission
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing at a counter in an interior setting that appears to be a post office. She is positioned side-on, leaning with one hand on the counter and the other hand resting on top. Her facial features are delicately drawn with a prominent nose, and her hair is styled smoothly and tied back. She is wearing a long, dark, voluminous dress adorned with lace detailing at the wrists and collar. Beside her, another woman is seen from behind, reaching up to the wall; her hair is styled back similarly. A third woman is seated at a table in the background, engaged in writing, her hair in a similar style. A man wearing a uniform and hat stands behind the counter, interacting with the woman at the counter, and a well-dressed man in a top hat stands beside him. The setting includes a high-ceilinged room with a decorative curtain draped overhead and illustrations or notices pinned to the walls. The floor is wooden, and the space feels active, with several occupants engaged in various tasks.

artworks.title: On the Beach - Two are Company, Three are None
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing on a beach holding a parasol over her right shoulder. She is looking to her right. She has an updo hairstyle and wears a hat with a wide brim and a ribbon. She is wearing a Victorian-style gown with a high collar, long sleeves, and ruffles. The background shows the ocean with waves, a cloudy sky, a small boat on the beach with two people, ships on the horizon, and birds flying in the sky.

artworks.title: The Nooning
artworks.description: The image shows a scene of three children and a dog relaxing on the grass. Two white houses with simple architecture are partially obscured by trees and shadows. The style is detailed with cross-hatching for texture and shading, resembling an engraving. The color palette is monochrome in sepia tones. Closest to the viewer is a boy lying on his stomach, with a group nearby. In the background, an older woman tends to chickens near one of the houses. The setting is shaded by trees, with laundry hanging in the distance.

artworks.title: Gloucester Harbor
artworks.description: The image shows a group of young boys in a rowing boat on the water, surrounded by sailing ships with tall masts and full sails. The boys are positioned in the boat in different ways, with three on one side and two on the other. The horizon is high in the image, and the water reflects the boats and sails. The artwork features fine and detailed brushwork, resembling traditional engraving or woodcut techniques. The color palette is monochrome, using varying densities of ink lines to create visual impact. The horizon lines create a sense of depth and distance in the vast sky.

artworks.title: Ship-Building, Gloucester Harbor
artworks.description: The image depicts a shipbuilding scene at Gloucester Harbor. In the foreground, four figures wearing hats are surrounded by tools, wood scraps, and baskets. A large ship is under construction in the background, supported by scaffolding and ladders, with figures on top working or supervising. The ground is littered with cut wood pieces, and planks and timber beams are scattered around. The scene conveys the industry and labor of shipbuilding, set against a possibly bustling harbor under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: "Dad's Coming!"
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals. One person is sitting on an overturned boat, facing away from the viewer towards the sea. The person wears a wide-brimmed straw hat, a dark long-sleeved top, and light-colored pants. The second person, a woman, is standing in profile while holding a child in her arms. The woman has dark hair tied back and wears a long dark dress with a lighter apron. The child has short hair and wears a striped outfit with buttons down the back. In the background, there is a view of the sea with sailboats, low clouds in the sky, fishing nets, and barrels on the rocky beach.

artworks.title: The Coolest Spot in New England - Summit of Mount Washington
artworks.description: The image depicts five people on the summit of Mount Washington. In the foreground, a man and a woman are seated on rocks. The man is shown from the side, partially reclining, and dressed in a buttoned shirt, trousers with suspenders, and wearing a hat with a brim. He has a mustache. The woman next to him, seated and facing slightly towards the left, has her hair styled up with a hat adorned with flowers. Her attire consists of a long-sleeved dress with pronounced detailing around the neck and shoulders. She is holding on to her hat delicately. Another woman stands at the center, her body shown from head to toe, facing away from the viewer and gazing into the distance. She wears an elaborate, layered dress and her hair is pinned up, covered with a hat decorated with flowers. Next to her, partially obscured and sitting on the ground, is another woman in similar period attire, including a dressed-up hat, with a scarf draped over her shoulders, facing right. Lastly, another man, seated on the edge of the image, is shown from the side wearing a suit, with a hat similar to the first man, and carrying a cane. The background features a roof labeled "Tip Top House" on the left and depicts expansive clouds above and a rugged landscape below.
